topics.title: Define the benefits of the AWS Cloud
topics.summary: Know why organizations choose AWS and how cloud characteristics improve speed, reach, resilience, and cost control.
points: Pay-as-you-go pricing replaces large upfront purchases with usage-based spending.
Agility means teams can provision resources quickly, experiment, and release faster.
Elasticity adds or removes resources as demand changes. Scalability increases capacity to support growth.
Multiple Availability Zones and Regions can improve availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery.
The AWS global footprint helps applications reach users with lower latency and supports geographic expansion.
Managed services reduce undifferentiated work such as hardware maintenance, patching, and some backups.
topics.examTip: When the question focuses on changing demand, think elasticity. When it focuses on long-term growth, think scalability.

zh.title: 定義 AWS 雲端的優勢
zh.summary: 了解組織為何選擇 AWS 以及雲端特性如何提高速度、覆蓋範圍、彈性和成本控制。
points: 即用即付定價模式以基於使用情況的支出取代了大量的預付費用。
敏捷性意味著團隊可以快速配置資源、進行實驗並更快地發布。
彈性會隨著需求的改變而增加或刪除資源。可擴展性提高了支援成長的能力。
多個可用區和區域可以提高可用性、容錯能力和災難復原能力。
AWS 的全球覆蓋範圍可協助應用程式以更低的延遲到達使用者並支援地理擴展。
託管服務減少了硬體維護、修補和一些備份等無差別的工作。
zh.examTip: 當問題集中在需求變化時，請考慮彈性。當關注長期成長時，請考慮可擴展性。

topics.title: Identify design principles of the AWS Cloud
topics.summary: Recognize the six AWS Well-Architected pillars and the design choices associated with each pillar.
points: Operational Excellence covers running, observing, and continually improving workloads.
Security covers identity, traceability, data protection, infrastructure protection, and incident preparation.
Reliability covers recovery, distributed design, capacity management, and automatic healing.
Performance Efficiency covers selecting and evolving efficient compute, storage, database, and network resources.
Cost Optimization covers eliminating waste, matching supply to demand, and measuring expenditure.
Sustainability covers reducing the environmental impact of running cloud workloads.
Common cloud design principles include automating changes, testing recovery, using loosely coupled components, and avoiding single points of failure.
topics.examTip: Map the main concern in the scenario to the pillar before choosing a service or action.

zh.title: 確定 AWS 雲端的設計原則
zh.summary: 認識 AWS 架構完善的六個支柱以及與每個支柱相關的設計選擇。
points: 卓越營運涵蓋運作、觀察和持續改善工作負載。
安全性涵蓋身分、可追溯性、資料保護、基礎設施保護和事件準備。
可靠性涵蓋恢復、分散式設計、容量管理和自動修復。
效能效率涵蓋選擇和發展高效的運算、儲存、資料庫和網路資源。
成本優化包括消除浪費、匹配供需、衡量支出。
永續性涵蓋減少運行雲端工作負載對環境的影響。
常見的雲端設計原則包括自動化變更、測試復原、使用鬆散耦合的元件以及避免單點故障。
zh.examTip: 在選擇服務或操作之前，將場景中的主要關注點映射到支柱。

topics.title: Understand the benefits of and strategies for migration to the AWS Cloud
topics.summary: Understand how organizations prepare for cloud adoption and choose a suitable migration path for each workload.
points: AWS Cloud Adoption Framework perspectives are Business, People, Governance, Platform, Security, and Operations.
A migration business case should connect technical change to risk reduction, efficiency, revenue, and business outcomes.
Common migration strategies include retire, retain, rehost, relocate, repurchase, replatform, and refactor.
AWS Application Migration Service supports server migration, while AWS Database Migration Service supports database migration with minimal downtime.
AWS Snow Family devices help transfer large data sets when network transfer is too slow or impractical.
Discovery, dependency mapping, testing, cutover planning, and validation reduce migration risk.
topics.examTip: Rehost means move with minimal change. Replatform makes limited cloud optimizations. Refactor changes the architecture significantly.

zh.title: 了解遷移到 AWS 雲端的優勢和策略
zh.summary: 了解組織如何為雲端採用做好準備，並為每個工作負載選擇合適的遷移路徑。
points: AWS 雲端採用框架的觀點包括業務、人員、治理、平台、安全性和營運。
遷移業務案例應將技術變革與降低風險、效率、收入和業務成果連結起來。
常見的遷移策略包括退役、保留、重新託管、重新定位、重新購買、重新平台和重構。
AWS Application Migration Service 支援伺服器遷移，而 AWS Database Migration Service 支援以最短的停機時間進行資料庫遷移。
當網路傳輸速度太慢或不切實際時，AWS Snow 系列設備可協助傳輸大型資料集。
發現、依賴關係映射、測試、切換規劃和驗證可降低遷移風險。
zh.examTip: 重新託管意味著以最小的改變進行移動。 Replatform 進行了有限的雲端優化。重構顯著改變了架構。

topics.title: Understand concepts of cloud economics
topics.summary: Know how cloud spending differs from on-premises spending and which practices reduce total cost.
points: On-premises environments usually require capital expenditure for hardware and facilities. Cloud services shift more spending to variable operating expenditure.
Total cost of ownership includes hardware, software, facilities, power, cooling, staffing, maintenance, and downtime risk.
AWS economies of scale help lower variable prices as aggregate platform usage grows.
Rightsizing matches resource size and type to actual workload needs instead of paying for idle capacity.
Automation can reduce repetitive operational work and the cost of human error.
Software licensing can use included licenses or Bring Your Own License, subject to vendor and service rules.
topics.examTip: Include indirect facility and staffing costs when comparing cloud cost with an on-premises data center.

zh.title: 了解雲端經濟的概念
zh.summary: 了解雲端支出與本地支出有何不同，以及哪些做法可以降低總成本。
points: 本地環境通常需要硬體和設施的資本支出。雲端服務將更多支出轉向可變營運支出。
總擁有成本包括硬體、軟體、設施、電力、冷卻、人員配備、維護和停機風險。
隨著平台總使用量的成長，AWS 的規模經濟有助於降低可變價格。
調整規模使資源大小和類型與實際工作負載需求相匹配，而不是為閒置容量付費。
自動化可以減少重複性操作工作和人為錯誤的成本。
軟體許可可以使用附帶的許可證或自備許可證，但須遵守供應商和服務規則。
zh.examTip: 將雲端成本與本地資料中心進行比較時，包括間接設施和人員成本。

zh.title: 雲概念

topics.title: Understand the AWS shared responsibility model
topics.summary: Separate AWS responsibility for security of the cloud from customer responsibility for security in the cloud.
points: AWS protects the facilities, physical hardware, networking, and virtualization layer that run AWS services.
Customers protect their data, identities, permissions, configurations, and applications.
With Amazon EC2, the customer manages the guest operating system, patches, installed software, and security group configuration.
With Amazon RDS, AWS manages more of the database platform and operating system, while the customer still manages data, access, and database configuration.
With AWS Lambda, AWS manages the servers and runtime infrastructure, while the customer manages code, data, permissions, and configuration.
Some controls are shared, including awareness, training, and configuration management responsibilities at different layers.
topics.examTip: The more managed the service is, the more infrastructure work AWS performs, but the customer always owns data and access decisions.

zh.title: 了解 AWS 責任共擔模型
zh.summary: 將 AWS 對雲端安全的責任與客戶對雲端安全的責任分開。
points: AWS 保護運作 AWS 服務的設施、實體硬體、網路和虛擬化層。
客戶保護他們的資料、身分、權限、配置和應用程式。
透過 Amazon EC2，客戶可以管理來賓作業系統、修補程式、安裝的軟體和安全性群組配置。
借助 Amazon RDS，AWS 可以管理更多的資料庫平台和作業系統，而客戶仍然可以管理資料、存取和資料庫配置。
借助 AWS Lambda，AWS 可以管理伺服器和執行時間基礎設施，而客戶則可以管理程式碼、資料、權限和配置。
一些控制是共享的，包括不同層的意識、培訓和配置管理職責。
zh.examTip: 服務的管理程度越高，AWS 執行的基礎設施工作就越多，但客戶始終擁有資料和存取決策權。

topics.title: Understand AWS Cloud security, governance, and compliance concepts
topics.summary: Know the main AWS services for evidence, audit, monitoring, threat detection, compliance, and encryption.
points: AWS Artifact provides AWS compliance reports and selected agreements on demand.
AWS CloudTrail records account activity and API calls. Amazon CloudWatch collects metrics, logs, dashboards, and alarms.
AWS Config records resource configuration changes and evaluates resources against rules.
AWS Audit Manager automates evidence collection, while AWS Security Hub centralizes supported security findings.
Amazon GuardDuty detects suspicious activity. Amazon Inspector finds supported workload vulnerabilities.
Encryption at rest protects stored data. Encryption in transit commonly uses TLS. AWS KMS manages encryption keys.
Compliance requirements can vary by industry, geography, data type, and the AWS service being used.
topics.examTip: CloudTrail answers who made an API call. CloudWatch answers what the workload is doing. Config answers how a resource configuration changed.

zh.title: 了解 AWS 雲端安全、治理和合規性概念
zh.summary: 了解用於證據、稽核、監控、威脅偵測、合規性和加密的主要 AWS 服務。
points: AWS Artifact 按需提供 AWS 合規性報告和選定的協定。
AWS CloudTrail 記錄帳戶活動和 API 呼叫。 Amazon CloudWatch 收集指標、日誌、控制面板和警報。
AWS Config 記錄資源配置變更並根據規則評估資源。
AWS Audit Manager 可自動收集證據，而 AWS Security Hub 則集中支援的安全調查結果。
Amazon GuardDuty 偵測可疑活動。 Amazon Inspector 發現受支援的工作負載漏洞。
靜態加密可保護儲存的資料。傳輸中的加密通常使用 TLS。 AWS KMS 管理加密金鑰。
合規性要求可能會因行業、地理位置、資料類型和所使用的 AWS 服務而異。
zh.examTip: CloudTrail 回答誰來進行了 API 呼叫。 CloudWatch 回答工作負載正在做什麼。 Config 回答資源配置如何變更。

topics.title: Identify AWS access management capabilities
topics.summary: Understand identities, authentication, authorization, federation, and safe credential practices.
points: Protect the root user with multi-factor authentication, do not create root access keys, and use root only for tasks that require it.
IAM users represent individual identities, groups collect users, and roles provide temporary credentials to trusted principals.
IAM policies define allowed or denied actions, resources, and conditions. Explicit deny overrides allow.
Least privilege grants only the permissions required for the task and should be refined over time.
IAM Identity Center provides centralized workforce access to multiple AWS accounts and applications.
Federation lets users authenticate through an external identity provider instead of creating separate long-lived IAM users.
Use AWS Secrets Manager or Systems Manager Parameter Store for suitable secrets instead of embedding credentials in code.
topics.examTip: Choose a role and temporary credentials for applications or cross-account access. Avoid long-lived access keys whenever possible.

zh.title: 識別 AWS 存取管理功能
zh.summary: 了解身分、身分驗證、授權、聯合和安全憑證實務。
points: 透過多重驗證保護 root 使用者，不建立 root 存取金鑰，並且僅將 root 用於需要它的任務。
IAM 使用者代表個人身份，群組收集使用者，角色為受信任的主體提供臨時憑證。
IAM 策略定義允許或拒絕的操作、資源和條件。顯式拒絕覆蓋允許。
最小權限僅授予任務所需的權限，並且應隨著時間的推移進行完善。
IAM Identity Center 提供多個 AWS 帳戶和應用程式的集中員工存取權。
聯合允許使用者透過外部身分提供者進行身份驗證，而不是建立單獨的長期 IAM 使用者。
使用 AWS Secrets Manager 或 Systems Manager Parameter Store 取得適當的金鑰，而不是在程式碼中嵌入憑證。
zh.examTip: 選擇應用程式或跨帳戶存取的角色和臨時憑證。盡可能避免長期存取密鑰。

topics.title: Identify components and resources for security
topics.summary: Distinguish AWS security services by the type of threat, control, or information they provide.
points: AWS WAF filters web requests using rules. AWS Shield provides managed protection against distributed denial of service attacks.
AWS Firewall Manager centrally manages firewall and related security policies across accounts and resources.
Amazon GuardDuty detects threats from supported telemetry, while Amazon Inspector assesses supported workloads for vulnerabilities.
AWS Security Hub aggregates and prioritizes findings from supported security services.
AWS Trusted Advisor checks supported areas such as cost, performance, security, resilience, and service limits.
AWS Marketplace includes third-party security products that can complement native AWS services.
Official security information is available through AWS documentation, the AWS Security Blog, security bulletins, and AWS re:Post or Knowledge Center resources.
topics.examTip: WAF is for application-layer web requests. Shield is for DDoS protection. GuardDuty is for threat detection.

zh.title: 識別安全組件和資源
zh.summary: 根據威脅、控製或提供的資訊的類型來區分 AWS 安全服務。
points: AWS WAF 使用規則過濾 Web 要求。 AWS Shield 提供針對分散式阻斷服務攻擊的託管保護。
AWS Firewall Manager 會跨帳戶和資源集中管理防火牆和相關安全性原則。
Amazon GuardDuty 偵測來自支援的遙測的威脅，而 Amazon Inspector 評估支援的工作負載是否有漏洞。
AWS Security Hub 匯總受支援的安全服務的結果並確定其優先順序。
AWS Trusted Advisor 檢查支援的領域，例如成本、效能、安全性、彈性和服務限制。
AWS Marketplace 包含可補充原生 AWS 服務的第三方安全產品。
官方安全資訊可透過 AWS 文件、AWS 安全部落格、安全公告以及 AWS re:Post 或知識中心資源取得。
zh.examTip: WAF用於應用層Web請求。 Shield 用於 DDoS 防護。 GuardDuty 用於威脅偵測。

zh.title: 安全與合規性

topics.title: Define methods of deploying and operating in the AWS Cloud
topics.summary: Know the main ways to access, provision, and operate AWS resources and the common deployment models.
points: The AWS Management Console provides browser-based administration.
The AWS CLI, SDKs, and service APIs support programmatic and automated access.
Infrastructure as code makes environments repeatable, versionable, and reviewable. AWS CloudFormation is the core AWS service for this approach.
One-time console actions can be appropriate for exploration, while repeatable production changes benefit from automation.
Cloud deployment runs workloads in a cloud environment. Hybrid deployment connects cloud and on-premises resources.
Permissions for every access method are still evaluated through AWS identity and resource policies.
topics.examTip: If a process must be repeatable across environments, prefer infrastructure as code over manual console steps.

zh.title: 定義在 AWS 雲端部署和操作的方法
zh.summary: 了解存取、配置和操作 AWS 資源的主要方式以及常見的部署模型。
points: AWS 管理主控台提供瀏覽器為基礎的管理。
AWS CLI、開發工具包和服務 API 支援程式設計和自動存取。
基礎設施即程式碼使環境可重複、可版本化和可審查。 AWS CloudFormation 是此方法的核心 AWS 服務。
一次性控制台操作適合探索，而可重複的生產變更則受益於自動化。
雲端部署在雲端環境中運行工作負載。混合部署連線雲端和本地資源。
每種存取方法的權限仍透過 AWS 身分和資源策略進行評估。
zh.examTip: 如果某個流程必須跨環境可重複，那麼優先選擇基礎架構即程式碼而不是手動控制台步驟。

topics.title: Define the AWS global infrastructure
topics.summary: Understand Regions, Availability Zones, edge locations, and how geography affects resilience, latency, and compliance.
points: A Region is a separate geographic area containing multiple isolated Availability Zones.
An Availability Zone contains one or more data centers with independent power, networking, and connectivity.
Deploying across multiple Availability Zones improves high availability and reduces single points of failure.
Multiple Regions can support disaster recovery, business continuity, low latency, and data residency requirements.
Edge locations place content and selected services closer to users. Amazon CloudFront uses edge locations for content delivery.
Region choice can depend on service availability, latency, compliance, and cost.
topics.examTip: Use multiple Availability Zones for high availability inside one Region. Use multiple Regions for geographic resilience or residency needs.

zh.title: 定義AWS全球基礎設施
zh.summary: 了解區域、可用區、邊緣位置以及地理位置如何影響彈性、延遲和合規性。
points: 區域是包含多個獨立可用區的獨立地理區域。
可用區包含一個或多個具有獨立電源、網路和連接的資料中心。
跨多個可用區部署可提高高可用性並減少單點故障。
多個區域可以支援災難復原、業務連續性、低延遲和資料駐留要求。
邊緣位置將內容和選定的服務放置在更靠近使用者的位置。 Amazon CloudFront 使用邊緣站點進行內容傳遞。
區域選擇可能取決於服務可用性、延遲、合規性和成本。
zh.examTip: 使用多個可用區在一個區域內實現高可用性。使用多個區域來滿足地理彈性或居住需求。

topics.title: Identify AWS compute services
topics.summary: Match virtual machines, containers, serverless compute, scaling, and load balancing to common use cases.
points: Amazon EC2 provides resizable virtual machines and gives customers operating system control.
General purpose, compute optimized, memory optimized, storage optimized, and accelerated instance families target different workload profiles.
EC2 Auto Scaling adjusts instance capacity, while Elastic Load Balancing distributes traffic across healthy targets.
AWS Lambda runs event-driven code without server management and charges based on requests and execution resources.
Amazon ECS orchestrates containers using AWS-native controls. Amazon EKS provides managed Kubernetes.
AWS Fargate supplies serverless compute capacity for supported ECS and EKS container workloads.
AWS Batch plans and runs batch computing jobs using suitable compute resources.
topics.examTip: Choose Lambda for event-driven functions, Fargate for serverless containers, and EC2 when operating system control is required.

zh.title: 識別 AWS 運算服務
zh.summary: 將虛擬機器、容器、無伺服器運算、擴充和負載平衡與常見用例相符。
points: Amazon EC2 提供可調整大小的虛擬機，並提供客戶作業系統控制權。
通用型、運算最佳化型、記憶體最佳化型、儲存最佳化型和加速型執行個體係列針對不同的工作負載配置。
EC2 Auto Scaling 調整執行個體容量，而 Elastic Load Balancing 則在健康目標之間分配流量。
AWS Lambda 會執行事件驅動的程式碼，無需伺服器管理，並根據請求和執行資源收費。
Amazon ECS 使用 AWS 原生控制項來編排容器。 Amazon EKS 提供託管 Kubernetes。
AWS Fargate 為支援的 ECS 和 EKS 容器工作負載提供無伺服器運算容量。
AWS Batch 使用適當的運算資源來規劃和執行大量運算作業。
zh.examTip: 對於事件驅動函數，選擇 Lambda；對於無伺服器容器，選擇 Fargate；當需要作業系統控制時，選擇 EC2。

topics.title: Identify AWS database services
topics.summary: Recognize relational, key-value, in-memory, and migration services and the value of managed databases.
points: Amazon RDS manages common relational database engines, including backups, patching, and selected high-availability features.
Amazon Aurora is a cloud-optimized relational database compatible with MySQL and PostgreSQL.
Amazon DynamoDB is a serverless NoSQL key-value and document database designed for scalable low-latency access.
Amazon ElastiCache provides managed in-memory caches using supported engines.
Running a database on EC2 gives more operating system control but also gives the customer more operational responsibility.
AWS Database Migration Service moves data between supported sources and targets. AWS Schema Conversion Tool helps convert database schemas.
topics.examTip: Start by identifying the data model: relational, key-value or document, or in-memory cache.

zh.title: 識別 AWS 資料庫服務
zh.summary: 認識關係、鍵值、記憶體和遷移服務以及託管資料庫的價值。
points: Amazon RDS 管理常見的關聯式資料庫引擎，包括備份、修補和選定的高可用性功能。
Amazon Aurora 是一種與 MySQL 和 PostgreSQL 相容的雲端最佳化關聯式資料庫。
Amazon DynamoDB 是一種無伺服器 NoSQL 鍵值和文件資料庫，專為可擴展的低延遲存取而設計。
Amazon ElastiCache 使用支援的引擎提供託管記憶體快取。
在 EC2 上運行資料庫可以提供更多的作業系統控制權，但也賦予客戶更多的營運責任。
AWS Database Migration Service 在支援的來源和目標之間移動資料。 AWS Schema Conversion Tool 可協助轉換資料庫架構。
zh.examTip: 首先確定資料模型：關係型、鍵值型、文檔型或記憶體快取型。

topics.title: Identify AWS network services
topics.summary: Understand VPC building blocks, traffic controls, DNS, and private connectivity to AWS.
points: Amazon VPC creates a logically isolated network with IP ranges, subnets, route tables, and gateways.
Public subnets have a route to an internet gateway. Private subnets do not directly expose resources to the internet.
Security groups are stateful resource-level controls. Network ACLs are stateless subnet-level controls.
Amazon Route 53 provides managed DNS, domain registration, routing policies, and health checks.
AWS Site-to-Site VPN provides encrypted connectivity over the internet.
AWS Direct Connect provides a dedicated private network connection from a location to AWS.
VPC endpoints provide private access from a VPC to supported services without traversing the public internet.
topics.examTip: Security groups remember connection state. Network ACLs require explicit rules for both traffic directions.

zh.title: 識別 AWS 網路服務
zh.summary: 了解 VPC 建置區塊、流量控制、DNS 以及與 AWS 的專用連線。
points: Amazon VPC 建立一個具有 IP 範圍、子網路、路由表和網關的邏輯隔離網路。
公共子網路有一條通往網際網路閘道的路由。私有子網路不會直接向網際網路公開資源。
安全群組是有狀態的資源層級控制。網路 ACL 是無狀態子網路層級控制。
Amazon Route 53 提供託管 DNS、網域註冊、路由原則和運作狀況檢查。
AWS Site-to-Site VPN 透過網際網路提供加密連線。
AWS Direct Connect 提供從某個位置到 AWS 的專用專用網路連線。
VPC 終端節點提供從 VPC 到支援的服務的私人存取，而無需遍歷公共互聯網。
zh.examTip: 安全群組會記住連線狀態。網路 ACL 需要針對兩個流量方向的明確規則。

topics.title: Identify AWS storage services
topics.summary: Distinguish object, block, file, hybrid, archival, and backup storage options.
points: Amazon S3 is regional object storage for objects stored in buckets. It is not a block disk or traditional file system.
S3 storage classes trade access cost, retrieval behavior, and minimum storage duration for lower storage price.
S3 lifecycle rules can transition or expire objects automatically.
Amazon EBS provides persistent block volumes for EC2. Instance store is temporary block storage tied to the host.
Amazon EFS provides managed elastic file storage for Linux workloads. Amazon FSx provides managed file systems for specific workloads and protocols.
AWS Storage Gateway connects on-premises environments to AWS storage through hybrid gateway modes.
AWS Backup centrally manages backup plans and retention for supported AWS resources.
topics.examTip: Object storage is S3, EC2 block storage is EBS, and shared Linux file storage is EFS.

zh.title: 識別 AWS 儲存服務
zh.summary: 區分物件、區塊、檔案、混合、歸檔和備份儲存選項。
points: Amazon S3 是儲存在儲存桶中的物件的區域物件儲存。它不是區塊磁碟或傳統的檔案系統。
S3 儲存類別以存取成本、檢索行為和最短儲存持續時間為代價，以降低儲存價格。
S3 生命週期規則可以自動轉換或過期物件。
Amazon EBS 為 EC2 提供持久性區塊磁碟區。執行個體儲存是與主機綁定的暫存區塊儲存。
Amazon EFS 為 Linux 工作負載提供託管彈性檔案儲存。 Amazon FSx 為特定工作負載和協定提供託管檔案系統。
AWS Storage Gateway 透過混合式閘道模式將本機環境連接到 AWS 儲存。
AWS Backup 集中管理支援的 AWS 資源的備份計畫和保留。
zh.examTip: 物件儲存是S3，EC2區塊儲存是EBS，共用Linux檔案儲存是EFS。

topics.title: Identify AWS AI/ML and analytics services
topics.summary: Match common managed AI, machine learning, streaming, preparation, query, and visualization services to their purpose.
points: Amazon SageMaker AI provides managed capabilities to build, train, and deploy machine learning models.
Amazon Lex builds conversational interfaces. Amazon Kendra provides intelligent enterprise search.
Amazon Rekognition analyzes images and video, while Amazon Comprehend extracts insights from text.
Amazon Athena runs SQL queries directly against supported data in Amazon S3.
Amazon Kinesis handles real-time streaming data. AWS Glue provides data integration, ETL, and a data catalog.
Amazon QuickSight provides business intelligence dashboards and visualizations.
Amazon Redshift is a managed data warehouse, while Amazon EMR runs managed big-data frameworks.
topics.examTip: Look for the task verb: query S3 with Athena, stream with Kinesis, transform with Glue, visualize with QuickSight.

zh.title: 識別 AWS AI/ML 和分析服務
zh.summary: 將常見的託管人工智慧、機器學習、串流媒體、準備、查詢和視覺化服務與其目的相匹配。
points: Amazon SageMaker AI 提供建置、訓練和部署機器學習模型的託管功能。
Amazon Lex 建立對話式介面。 Amazon Kendra 提供智慧企業搜尋。
Amazon Rekognition 分析圖像和視頻，而 Amazon Comprehend 從文本中提取見解。
Amazon Athena 直接針對 Amazon S3 中支援的資料執行 SQL 查詢。
Amazon Kinesis 處理即時串流資料。 AWS Glue 提供資料整合、ETL 和資料目錄。
Amazon QuickSight 提供商業智慧儀表板和視覺化。
Amazon Redshift 是託管資料倉儲，而 Amazon EMR 則運行託管大資料框架。
zh.examTip: 尋找任務動詞：使用 Athena 查詢 S3、使用 Kinesis 進行串流、使用 Glue 進行轉換、使用 QuickSight 進行視覺化。

topics.title: Identify services from other in-scope AWS service categories
topics.summary: Recognize important application integration, business, developer, end-user, frontend, and IoT services.
points: Amazon SQS decouples components with queues. Amazon SNS fans messages out to subscribers. Amazon EventBridge routes events using rules.
Amazon SES sends email, while Amazon Connect provides a cloud contact center.
AWS CodeBuild runs builds, AWS CodePipeline orchestrates delivery stages, and AWS X-Ray traces distributed applications.
Amazon WorkSpaces provides managed virtual desktops. AppStream 2.0 streams applications to users.
AWS Amplify helps build and deploy web and mobile applications. AWS AppSync provides managed GraphQL APIs.
AWS IoT Core connects and manages communication with IoT devices.
AWS Support, AWS Marketplace, documentation, and community resources help customers adopt and operate AWS.
topics.examTip: Queue is SQS, publish and subscribe is SNS, and rule-based event routing is EventBridge.

zh.title: 識別範圍內其他 AWS 服務類別中的服務
zh.summary: 識別重要的應用程式整合、業務、開發人員、最終使用者、前端和物聯網服務。
points: Amazon SQS 將元件與佇列解耦。 Amazon SNS 將訊息扇形傳播給訂閱者。 Amazon EventBridge 使用規則路由事件。
Amazon SES 發送電子郵件，而 Amazon Connect 提供雲端聯絡中心。
AWS CodeBuild 運行構建，AWS CodePipeline 協調交付階段，AWS X-Ray 追蹤分散式應用程式。
Amazon WorkSpaces 提供託管虛擬桌面。 AppStream 2.0 將應用程式串流傳輸給使用者。
AWS Amplify 協助建置和部署 Web 和行動應用程式。 AWS AppSync 提供託管 GraphQL API。
AWS IoT Core 連線並管理與 IoT 裝置的通訊。
AWS Support、AWS Marketplace、文件和社群資源可協助客戶採用和營運 AWS。
zh.examTip: 佇列是SQS，發布訂閱是SNS，基於規則的事件路由是EventBridge。

zh.title: 雲端技術與服務

topics.title: Compare AWS pricing models
topics.summary: Know how compute commitments, spare capacity, tenancy, reservations, data transfer, and storage tiers affect price.
points: On-Demand pricing has no long-term commitment and suits short-term, irregular, or unpredictable workloads.
Savings Plans reduce eligible compute cost in exchange for a consistent usage commitment measured per hour.
Reserved Instances provide billing discounts and, for some types, capacity-related benefits for eligible EC2 usage.
Spot Instances use spare EC2 capacity at a discount but can be interrupted, so workloads must tolerate interruption.
Dedicated Hosts provide a physical server for one customer and can support certain licensing requirements. Dedicated Instances run on single-tenant hardware with less host-level visibility.
Capacity Reservations reserve EC2 capacity in an Availability Zone but do not automatically provide a usage discount.
Inbound internet data transfer is commonly free, while outbound and cross-Region transfer can incur charges. Always check the service pricing page.
topics.examTip: Capacity availability and billing discount are different goals. A Capacity Reservation addresses capacity, while Savings Plans primarily address price.

zh.title: 比較 AWS 定價模型
zh.summary: 了解運算承諾、備用容量、租賃、預留、資料傳輸和儲存層如何影響價格。
points: 按需定價沒有長期承諾，適合短期、不規則或不可預測的工作負載。
Savings Plans 降低了符合條件的計算成本，以換取每小時測量的一致使用承諾。
預留執行個體為符合資格的 EC2 使用提供帳單折扣，對於某些類型，還提供與容量相關的優惠。
Spot 執行個體以折扣價使用備用 EC2 容量，但可以中斷，因此工作負載必須容忍中斷。
專用主機為一個客戶提供一台實體伺服器，並且可以支援某些許可要求。專用執行個體在單一租使用者硬體上運行，主機級可見度較低。
容量預留在可用區預留 EC2 容量，但不會自動提供使用折扣。
入站網路資料傳輸通常是免費的，而出站和跨區域傳輸可能會產生費用。請務必檢查服務定價頁面。
zh.examTip: 容量可用性和計費折扣是不同的目標。容量預留解決容量問題，而節省計畫主要解決價格問題。

topics.title: Understand resources for billing, budget, and cost management
topics.summary: Distinguish forecasting, alerting, estimation, detailed reporting, allocation, and consolidated billing tools.
points: AWS Cost Explorer visualizes historical cost and usage and provides forecasts and filtering.
AWS Budgets tracks cost, usage, reservations, or Savings Plans against thresholds and can send alerts.
AWS Pricing Calculator estimates the cost of a planned architecture before deployment.
AWS Cost and Usage Reports provides detailed billing and usage data for analysis.
Cost allocation tags categorize spending by dimensions such as project, owner, environment, or cost center after activation.
AWS Organizations consolidated billing combines member-account charges under a management account and can share eligible volume benefits.
Billing dashboards and service pricing pages help explain current charges and service-specific pricing dimensions.
topics.examTip: Estimate future architecture cost with Pricing Calculator, analyze actual spend with Cost Explorer, and alert on thresholds with Budgets.

zh.title: 了解計費、預算和成本管理資源
zh.summary: 區分預測、警報、估計、詳細報告、分配和綜合計費工具。
points: AWS Cost Explorer 視覺化歷史成本和使用情況，並提供預測和過濾。
AWS Budgets 根據門檻追蹤成本、使用情況、預訂或儲蓄計劃，並可以發送警報。
AWS 定價計算器在部署前估算規劃架構的成本。
AWS 成本和使用情況報告提供詳細的帳單和使用資料以供分析。
成本分配標籤在啟動後按項目、所有者、環境或成本中心等維度對支出進行分類。
AWS Organizations 整合帳單將會員帳戶費用合併到管理帳戶下，並可分享符合資格的批量權益。
計費儀表板和服務定價頁面有助於解釋當前費用和特定於服務的定價維度。
zh.examTip: 使用定價計算器估算未來架構成本，使用 Cost Explorer 分析實際支出，並使用預算提醒門檻。

topics.title: Identify AWS technical resources and AWS Support options
topics.summary: Know where to find self-service guidance, account health information, partner solutions, and expert support.
points: AWS documentation, whitepapers, blogs, Architecture Center, and Prescriptive Guidance provide official technical guidance.
AWS re:Post and AWS Knowledge Center provide community and troubleshooting knowledge.
AWS Support plans provide different levels of technical assistance and response targets. Higher plans add broader production support and proactive guidance.
AWS Trusted Advisor provides checks and recommendations in supported categories. Available checks depend on the support plan and account features.
AWS Health Dashboard shows service events and account-specific events. AWS Health API enables programmatic access for eligible plans.
AWS Marketplace offers third-party software, data, and services with centralized procurement and billing options.
AWS Partners include independent software vendors and system integrators. AWS Professional Services and Solutions Architects can provide specialist guidance.
The AWS Trust and Safety team handles reports of abusive activity involving AWS resources.
topics.examTip: Use AWS Health for events affecting services or your account. Use Trusted Advisor for recommendations about your environment.

zh.title: 確定 AWS 技術資源和 AWS Support選項
zh.summary: 了解在哪裡可以找到自助服務指南、帳戶運行狀況資訊、合作夥伴解決方案和專家支援。
points: AWS 文件、白皮書、部落格、架構中心和規範指南提供官方技術指導。
AWS re:Post 和 AWS 知識中心提供社群和故障排除知識。
AWS Support計畫提供不同層級的技術援助和回應目標。更高的計劃增加了更廣泛的生產支援和主動指導。
AWS Trusted Advisor 在支援的類別中提供檢查和建議。可用的支票取決於支援計劃和帳戶功能。
AWS Health Dashboard 顯示服務事件和帳號特定事件。 AWS Health API 支援對符合條件的計畫進行程式存取。
AWS Marketplace 提供具有集中採購和計費選項的第三方軟體、資料和服務。
AWS 合作夥伴包括獨立軟體供應商和系統整合商。 AWS 專業服務和解決方案架構師可以提供專家指導。
AWS 信任和安全團隊處理涉及 AWS 資源的濫用活動的報告。
zh.examTip: 使用 AWS Health 來處理影響服務或您帳戶的事件。使用 Trusted Advisor 取得有關您的環境的建議。

zh.title: 計費、定價和支持

commonMistakes.title: Common mistakes
commonMistakes.summary: Use this checklist before submitting a AWS Cloud Practitioner practice exam. These mistakes commonly turn a technically possible choice into the wrong exam answer.
points: Do not treat Pay as you go and Agility as interchangeable. Match the exact capability, scope, and operational model requested by the scenario.
Do not stop at a solution that works. Words such as most secure, least operational effort, lowest cost, and highly available determine which valid design is best.
Do not ignore scope. Confirm whether the requirement applies to one resource, one Availability Zone, one Region, multiple accounts, or a global workload.
Do not confuse high availability, fault tolerance, backup, and disaster recovery. Each addresses a different failure or recovery requirement.
Do not overlook identity, encryption, logging, and least privilege. Security requirements remain relevant even when the question mainly tests another domain.
For multiple-response questions, evaluate every option independently and select only the number of answers requested.
commonMistakes.examTip: Read the final sentence first, identify the decision being requested, and verify that every selected answer satisfies all explicit constraints.

zh.title: 常見錯誤
zh.summary: 在提交 AWS Cloud Practitioner 模擬考試之前，請使用此清單。這些錯誤通常會將技術上可行的選擇變成錯誤的考試答案。
points: 不要將隨用隨付和敏捷性視為可以互換的。匹配場景所要求的確切功能、範圍和操作模型。
不要停留在有效的解決方案上。最安全、最少的營運工作、最低的成本和高度可用性等字詞決定了哪種有效設計是最好的。
不要忽視範圍。確認該要求是否適用於一項資源、一個可用區、一個區域、多個帳戶或全域工作負載。
不要混淆高可用性、容錯、備份和災難復原。每個解決不同的故障或恢復要求。
不要忽視身分、加密、日誌和最小權限。即使問題主要測試另一個網域，安全要求仍然相關。
對於多項回答問題，獨立評估每個選項並僅選擇所需的答案數量。
zh.examTip: 首先閱讀最後一句話，確定所要求的決策，並驗證每個選定的答案是否滿足所有明確的限制。

topics.title: Design secure access to AWS resources
topics.summary: This section focuses on design secure access to aws resources within Design Secure Architectures. Learn to recognize the requirement, select an appropriate AWS approach, and explain the important trade-offs.
points: Define the requirement behind this task: Design secure access to AWS resources. Identify the business goal, technical constraint, and success measure before selecting a service.
SSE-S3 uses Amazon S3 managed keys (AES-256) with no customer involvement, no per-key policies, and no KMS audit trail.
AWS CloudHSM provides dedicated HSM instances. KMS is a managed key service but uses shared infrastructure. Secrets Manager stores secrets, not HSM keys. ACM manages SSL/TLS certificates.
A bucket policy with a Condition element can restrict access to a specific IAM role ARN. ACLs are legacy and less precise. Object Lock prevents deletion. Versioning preserves object versions.

VPC Flow Logs capture information about IP traffic going to and from network interfaces in a VPC. VPC Peering connects VPCs. NAT Gateway enables outbound internet for private subnets. Internet Gateway connects a VPC to the internet.
keyTerms: S3 bucket policy with a Condition element
topics.examTip: For Task 1.1, underline the required outcome and every constraint. Eliminate choices that solve a different problem, then compare the remaining choices for operational effort, resilience, security, performance, and cost.

zh.title: 設計對 AWS 資源的安全存取
zh.summary: 本節重點介紹設計安全架構中對 aws 資源的設計安全存取。了解識別需求、選擇適當的 AWS 方法並解釋重要的權衡。
points: 定義此任務背後的要求：設計對 AWS 資源的安全存取。在選擇服務之前確定業務目標、技術約束和成功衡量標準。
SSE-S3 使用 Amazon S3 託管金鑰 (AES-256)，無需客戶參與，沒有每個金鑰策略，也沒有 KMS 稽核追蹤。
AWS CloudHSM 提供專用 HSM 執行個體。 KMS 是一種託管金鑰服務，但使用共用基礎架構。 Secrets Manager 儲存機密，而不是 HSM 金鑰。 ACM 管理 SSL/TLS 憑證。
具有 Condition 元素的儲存桶策略可以限制對特定 IAM 角色 ARN 的存取。 ACL 是遺留的並且不太精確。物件鎖定防止刪除。版本控制保留物件版本。
VPC 流日誌可擷取進出 VPC 中網路介面的 IP 流量的資訊。 VPC 對等互連連接 VPC。 NAT 閘道為私有子網路啟用出站網際網路。 Internet 閘道將 VPC 連接到 Internet。
keyTerms: 帶有 Condition 元素的 S3 儲存桶策略
zh.examTip: 對於任務 1.1，強調所需的結果和每項限制。消除解決不同問題的選擇，然後比較剩餘選擇的營運工作量、彈性、安全性、效能和成本。

topics.title: Design secure workloads and applications
topics.summary: This section focuses on design secure workloads and applications within Design Secure Architectures. Learn to recognize the requirement, select an appropriate AWS approach, and explain the important trade-offs.
points: Define the requirement behind this task: Design secure workloads and applications. Identify the business goal, technical constraint, and success measure before selecting a service.
A bucket policy with a Condition element can restrict access to a specific IAM role ARN. ACLs are legacy and less precise. Object Lock prevents deletion. Versioning preserves object versions.

VPC Flow Logs capture information about IP traffic going to and from network interfaces in a VPC. VPC Peering connects VPCs. NAT Gateway enables outbound internet for private subnets. Internet Gateway connects a VPC to the internet.
AWS CloudTrail records API calls made to AWS services. CloudWatch monitors metrics and logs. AWS Config tracks resource configurations. GuardDuty is a threat detection service.
A cross-account IAM role with a narrowly scoped trust policy and permissions policy avoids long-lived credentials and limits access to the required bucket actions.
keyTerms: S3 bucket policy with a Condition element
An AWS Organizations service control policy
A bucket policy in the resource account
topics.examTip: For Task 1.2, underline the required outcome and every constraint. Eliminate choices that solve a different problem, then compare the remaining choices for operational effort, resilience, security, performance, and cost.

zh.title: 設計安全的工作負載和應用程式
zh.summary: 本節重點介紹設計安全架構中的設計安全工作負載和應用程式。了解識別需求、選擇適當的 AWS 方法並解釋重要的權衡。
points: 定義此任務背後的要求：設計安全的工作負載和應用程式。在選擇服務之前確定業務目標、技術約束和成功衡量標準。
具有 Condition 元素的儲存桶策略可以限制對特定 IAM 角色 ARN 的存取。 ACL 是遺留的並且不太精確。物件鎖定防止刪除。版本控制保留物件版本。
VPC 流日誌可擷取進出 VPC 中網路介面的 IP 流量的資訊。 VPC 對等互連連接 VPC。 NAT 閘道為私有子網路啟用出站網際網路。 Internet 閘道將 VPC 連接到 Internet。
AWS CloudTrail 記錄對 AWS 服務進行的 API 呼叫。 CloudWatch 監控指標和日誌。 AWS Config 追蹤資源配置。 GuardDuty 是一項威脅偵測服務。
具有範圍狹窄的信任策略和權限策略的跨帳戶 IAM 角色可避免長期憑證並限制對所需儲存桶操作的存取。
keyTerms: 帶有 Condition 元素的 S3 儲存桶策略
AWS Organizations 服務控制原則
資源帳戶中的儲存桶策略
zh.examTip: 對於任務 1.2，強調所需的結果和每項限制。消除解決不同問題的選擇，然後比較剩餘選擇的營運工作量、彈性、安全性、效能和成本。

topics.title: Determine appropriate data security controls
topics.summary: This section focuses on determine appropriate data security controls within Design Secure Architectures. Learn to recognize the requirement, select an appropriate AWS approach, and explain the important trade-offs.
points: Define the requirement behind this task: Determine appropriate data security controls. Identify the business goal, technical constraint, and success measure before selecting a service.
AWS CloudTrail records API calls made to AWS services. CloudWatch monitors metrics and logs. AWS Config tracks resource configurations. GuardDuty is a threat detection service.
A cross-account IAM role with a narrowly scoped trust policy and permissions policy avoids long-lived credentials and limits access to the required bucket actions.
AWS IAM Identity Center provides centralized workforce access with federated identities and permission sets across AWS accounts.
A service control policy can set a maximum permissions boundary for member accounts and deny actions such as disabling CloudTrail.
keyTerms: An AWS Organizations service control policy
A bucket policy in the resource account
An IAM policy in the principal account
Route outbound traffic through a NAT gateway in a public subnet

zh.title: 確定適當的資料安全控制措施
zh.summary: 本節重點討論在設計安全架構中確定適當的資料安全控制。了解識別需求、選擇適當的 AWS 方法並解釋重要的權衡。
points: 定義此任務背後的要求：確定適當的資料安全控制。在選擇服務之前確定業務目標、技術約束和成功衡量標準。

commonMistakes.title: Common mistakes
commonMistakes.summary: Use this checklist before submitting a AWS Solutions Architect - Associate practice exam. These mistakes commonly turn a technically possible choice into the wrong exam answer.
points: Do not treat SSE-S3 and AWS CloudHSM as interchangeable. Match the exact capability, scope, and operational model requested by the scenario.
Do not stop at a solution that works. Words such as most secure, least operational effort, lowest cost, and highly available determine which valid design is best.
Do not ignore scope. Confirm whether the requirement applies to one resource, one Availability Zone, one Region, multiple accounts, or a global workload.
Do not confuse high availability, fault tolerance, backup, and disaster recovery. Each addresses a different failure or recovery requirement.
Do not overlook identity, encryption, logging, and least privilege. Security requirements remain relevant even when the question mainly tests another domain.
For multiple-response questions, evaluate every option independently and select only the number of answers requested.
commonMistakes.examTip: Read the final sentence first, identify the decision being requested, and verify that every selected answer satisfies all explicit constraints.

commonMistakes.title: Common mistakes
commonMistakes.summary: Use this checklist before submitting a AWS Certified AI Practitioner practice exam. These mistakes commonly turn a technically possible choice into the wrong exam answer.
points: Do not treat Amazon SageMaker AI and Amazon CloudFront as interchangeable. Match the exact capability, scope, and operational model requested by the scenario.
Do not stop at a solution that works. Words such as most secure, least operational effort, lowest cost, and highly available determine which valid design is best.
Do not ignore scope. Confirm whether the requirement applies to one resource, one Availability Zone, one Region, multiple accounts, or a global workload.
Do not confuse high availability, fault tolerance, backup, and disaster recovery. Each addresses a different failure or recovery requirement.
Do not overlook identity, encryption, logging, and least privilege. Security requirements remain relevant even when the question mainly tests another domain.
For multiple-response questions, evaluate every option independently and select only the number of answers requested.
commonMistakes.examTip: Read the final sentence first, identify the decision being requested, and verify that every selected answer satisfies all explicit constraints.

zh.title: 常見錯誤
zh.summary: 在提交 AWS 認證 AI 從業者模擬考試之前，請使用此清單。這些錯誤通常會將技術上可行的選擇變成錯誤的考試答案。
points: 請勿將 Amazon SageMaker AI 和 Amazon CloudFront 視為可以互換。匹配場景所要求的確切功能、範圍和操作模型。
不要停留在有效的解決方案上。最安全、最少的營運工作、最低的成本和高度可用性等字詞決定了哪種有效設計是最好的。
不要忽視範圍。確認該要求是否適用於一項資源、一個可用區、一個區域、多個帳戶或全域工作負載。
不要混淆高可用性、容錯、備份和災難復原。每個解決不同的故障或恢復要求。
不要忽視身分、加密、日誌和最小權限。即使問題主要測試另一個網域，安全要求仍然相關。
對於多項回答問題，獨立評估每個選項並僅選擇所需的答案數量。
zh.examTip: 首先閱讀最後一句話，確定所要求的決策，並驗證每個選定的答案是否滿足所有明確的限制。

commonMistakes.title: Common mistakes
commonMistakes.summary: Use this checklist before submitting a AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer - Associate practice exam. These mistakes commonly turn a technically possible choice into the wrong exam answer.
points: Do not treat A CloudWatch custom metric and The CloudWatch agent as interchangeable. Match the exact capability, scope, and operational model requested by the scenario.
Do not stop at a solution that works. Words such as most secure, least operational effort, lowest cost, and highly available determine which valid design is best.
Do not ignore scope. Confirm whether the requirement applies to one resource, one Availability Zone, one Region, multiple accounts, or a global workload.
Do not confuse high availability, fault tolerance, backup, and disaster recovery. Each addresses a different failure or recovery requirement.
Do not overlook identity, encryption, logging, and least privilege. Security requirements remain relevant even when the question mainly tests another domain.
For multiple-response questions, evaluate every option independently and select only the number of answers requested.
commonMistakes.examTip: Read the final sentence first, identify the decision being requested, and verify that every selected answer satisfies all explicit constraints.

zh.title: 常見錯誤
zh.summary: 在提交 AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer - Associate 模擬考試之前，請使用此清單。這些錯誤通常會將技術上可行的選擇變成錯誤的考試答案。
points: 請勿將 CloudWatch 自訂指標和 CloudWatch 代理視為可互換的。匹配場景所要求的確切功能、範圍和操作模型。
不要停留在有效的解決方案上。最安全、最少的營運工作、最低的成本和高度可用性等字詞決定了哪種有效設計是最好的。
不要忽視範圍。確認該要求是否適用於一項資源、一個可用區、一個區域、多個帳戶或全域工作負載。
不要混淆高可用性、容錯、備份和災難復原。每個解決不同的故障或恢復要求。
不要忽視身分、加密、日誌和最小權限。即使問題主要測試另一個網域，安全要求仍然相關。
對於多項回答問題，獨立評估每個選項並僅選擇所需的答案數量。
zh.examTip: 首先閱讀最後一句話，確定所要求的決策，並驗證每個選定的答案是否滿足所有明確的限制。

commonMistakes.title: Common mistakes
commonMistakes.summary: Use this checklist before submitting a AWS Certified Data Engineer - Associate practice exam. These mistakes commonly turn a technically possible choice into the wrong exam answer.
points: Do not treat Amazon Kinesis Data Streams and AWS Glue as interchangeable. Match the exact capability, scope, and operational model requested by the scenario.
Do not stop at a solution that works. Words such as most secure, least operational effort, lowest cost, and highly available determine which valid design is best.
Do not ignore scope. Confirm whether the requirement applies to one resource, one Availability Zone, one Region, multiple accounts, or a global workload.
Do not confuse high availability, fault tolerance, backup, and disaster recovery. Each addresses a different failure or recovery requirement.
Do not overlook identity, encryption, logging, and least privilege. Security requirements remain relevant even when the question mainly tests another domain.
For multiple-response questions, evaluate every option independently and select only the number of answers requested.
commonMistakes.examTip: Read the final sentence first, identify the decision being requested, and verify that every selected answer satisfies all explicit constraints.

zh.title: 常見錯誤
zh.summary: 在提交 AWS 認證資料工程師 - 助理模擬考試之前，請使用此清單。這些錯誤通常會將技術上可行的選擇變成錯誤的考試答案。
points: 請勿將 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 和 AWS Glue 視為可互換。匹配場景所要求的確切功能、範圍和操作模型。
不要停留在有效的解決方案上。最安全、最少的營運工作、最低的成本和高度可用性等字詞決定了哪種有效設計是最好的。
不要忽視範圍。確認該要求是否適用於一項資源、一個可用區、一個區域、多個帳戶或全域工作負載。
不要混淆高可用性、容錯、備份和災難復原。每個解決不同的故障或恢復要求。
不要忽視身分、加密、日誌和最小權限。即使問題主要測試另一個網域，安全要求仍然相關。
對於多項回答問題，獨立評估每個選項並僅選擇所需的答案數量。
zh.examTip: 首先閱讀最後一句話，確定所要求的決策，並驗證每個選定的答案是否滿足所有明確的限制。

commonMistakes.title: Common mistakes
commonMistakes.summary: Use this checklist before submitting a AWS Certified Developer - Associate practice exam. These mistakes commonly turn a technically possible choice into the wrong exam answer.
points: Do not treat Publish an event to an Amazon SNS topic and An asynchronous Lambda invocation as interchangeable. Match the exact capability, scope, and operational model requested by the scenario.
Do not stop at a solution that works. Words such as most secure, least operational effort, lowest cost, and highly available determine which valid design is best.
Do not ignore scope. Confirm whether the requirement applies to one resource, one Availability Zone, one Region, multiple accounts, or a global workload.
Do not confuse high availability, fault tolerance, backup, and disaster recovery. Each addresses a different failure or recovery requirement.
Do not overlook identity, encryption, logging, and least privilege. Security requirements remain relevant even when the question mainly tests another domain.
For multiple-response questions, evaluate every option independently and select only the number of answers requested.
commonMistakes.examTip: Read the final sentence first, identify the decision being requested, and verify that every selected answer satisfies all explicit constraints.

zh.title: 常見錯誤
zh.summary: 在提交 AWS Certified Developer - Associate 模擬考試之前，請使用此清單。這些錯誤通常會將技術上可行的選擇變成錯誤的考試答案。
points: 請勿將發布事件到 Amazon SNS 主題和非同步 Lambda 呼叫視為可互換的。匹配場景所要求的確切功能、範圍和操作模型。
不要停留在有效的解決方案上。最安全、最少的營運工作、最低的成本和高度可用性等字詞決定了哪種有效設計是最好的。
不要忽視範圍。確認該要求是否適用於一項資源、一個可用區、一個區域、多個帳戶或全域工作負載。
不要混淆高可用性、容錯、備份和災難復原。每個解決不同的故障或恢復要求。
不要忽視身分、加密、日誌和最小權限。即使問題主要測試另一個網域，安全要求仍然相關。
對於多項回答問題，獨立評估每個選項並僅選擇所需的答案數量。
zh.examTip: 首先閱讀最後一句話，確定所要求的決策，並驗證每個選定的答案是否滿足所有明確的限制。

commonMistakes.title: Common mistakes
commonMistakes.summary: Use this checklist before submitting a AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate practice exam. These mistakes commonly turn a technically possible choice into the wrong exam answer.
points: Do not treat Data cleaning and validation and Amazon SageMaker Processing as interchangeable. Match the exact capability, scope, and operational model requested by the scenario.
Do not stop at a solution that works. Words such as most secure, least operational effort, lowest cost, and highly available determine which valid design is best.
Do not ignore scope. Confirm whether the requirement applies to one resource, one Availability Zone, one Region, multiple accounts, or a global workload.
Do not confuse high availability, fault tolerance, backup, and disaster recovery. Each addresses a different failure or recovery requirement.
Do not overlook identity, encryption, logging, and least privilege. Security requirements remain relevant even when the question mainly tests another domain.
For multiple-response questions, evaluate every option independently and select only the number of answers requested.
commonMistakes.examTip: Read the final sentence first, identify the decision being requested, and verify that every selected answer satisfies all explicit constraints.

zh.title: 常見錯誤
zh.summary: 在提交 AWS 認證機器學習工程師 - 助理模擬考試之前，請使用此清單。這些錯誤通常會將技術上可行的選擇變成錯誤的考試答案。
points: 請勿將資料清理和驗證與 Amazon SageMaker Processing視為可互換。匹配場景所要求的確切功能、範圍和操作模型。
不要停留在有效的解決方案上。最安全、最少的營運工作、最低的成本和高度可用性等字詞決定了哪種有效設計是最好的。
不要忽視範圍。確認該要求是否適用於一項資源、一個可用區、一個區域、多個帳戶或全域工作負載。
不要混淆高可用性、容錯、備份和災難復原。每個解決不同的故障或恢復要求。
不要忽視身分、加密、日誌和最小權限。即使問題主要測試另一個網域，安全要求仍然相關。
對於多項回答問題，獨立評估每個選項並僅選擇所需的答案數量。
zh.examTip: 首先閱讀最後一句話，確定所要求的決策，並驗證每個選定的答案是否滿足所有明確的限制。

commonMistakes.title: Common mistakes
commonMistakes.summary: Use this checklist before submitting a AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional practice exam. These mistakes commonly turn a technically possible choice into the wrong exam answer.
points: Do not treat AWS CodePipeline and AWS CodeBuild as interchangeable. Match the exact capability, scope, and operational model requested by the scenario.
Do not stop at a solution that works. Words such as most secure, least operational effort, lowest cost, and highly available determine which valid design is best.
Do not ignore scope. Confirm whether the requirement applies to one resource, one Availability Zone, one Region, multiple accounts, or a global workload.
Do not confuse high availability, fault tolerance, backup, and disaster recovery. Each addresses a different failure or recovery requirement.
Do not overlook identity, encryption, logging, and least privilege. Security requirements remain relevant even when the question mainly tests another domain.
For multiple-response questions, evaluate every option independently and select only the number of answers requested.
commonMistakes.examTip: Read the final sentence first, identify the decision being requested, and verify that every selected answer satisfies all explicit constraints.

zh.title: 常見錯誤
zh.summary: 在提交 AWS 認證開發營運工程師 - 專業練習考試之前，請使用此清單。這些錯誤通常會將技術上可行的選擇變成錯誤的考試答案。
points: 請勿將 AWS CodePipeline 和 AWS CodeBuild 視為可互換。匹配場景所要求的確切功能、範圍和操作模型。
不要停留在有效的解決方案上。最安全、最少的營運工作、最低的成本和高度可用性等字詞決定了哪種有效設計是最好的。
不要忽視範圍。確認該要求是否適用於一項資源、一個可用區、一個區域、多個帳戶或全域工作負載。
不要混淆高可用性、容錯、備份和災難復原。每個解決不同的故障或恢復要求。
不要忽視身分、加密、日誌和最小權限。即使問題主要測試另一個網域，安全要求仍然相關。
對於多項回答問題，獨立評估每個選項並僅選擇所需的答案數量。
zh.examTip: 首先閱讀最後一句話，確定所要求的決策，並驗證每個選定的答案是否滿足所有明確的限制。

commonMistakes.title: Common mistakes
commonMistakes.summary: Use this checklist before submitting a AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional practice exam. These mistakes commonly turn a technically possible choice into the wrong exam answer.
points: Do not treat Retrieval Augmented Generation with a knowledge base and A vector index in an approved vector store as interchangeable. Match the exact capability, scope, and operational model requested by the scenario.
Do not stop at a solution that works. Words such as most secure, least operational effort, lowest cost, and highly available determine which valid design is best.
Do not ignore scope. Confirm whether the requirement applies to one resource, one Availability Zone, one Region, multiple accounts, or a global workload.
Do not confuse high availability, fault tolerance, backup, and disaster recovery. Each addresses a different failure or recovery requirement.
Do not overlook identity, encryption, logging, and least privilege. Security requirements remain relevant even when the question mainly tests another domain.
For multiple-response questions, evaluate every option independently and select only the number of answers requested.
commonMistakes.examTip: Read the final sentence first, identify the decision being requested, and verify that every selected answer satisfies all explicit constraints.

zh.title: 常見錯誤
zh.summary: 在提交 AWS 認證生成式 AI 開發人員 - 專業練習考試之前，請使用此清單。這些錯誤通常會將技術上可行的選擇變成錯誤的考試答案。
points: 請勿將帶有知識庫的檢索增強生成和經批准的向量存儲中的向量索引視為可互換的。匹配場景所要求的確切功能、範圍和操作模型。
不要停留在有效的解決方案上。最安全、最少的營運工作、最低的成本和高度可用性等字詞決定了哪種有效設計是最好的。
不要忽視範圍。確認該要求是否適用於一項資源、一個可用區、一個區域、多個帳戶或全域工作負載。
不要混淆高可用性、容錯、備份和災難復原。每個解決不同的故障或恢復要求。
不要忽視身分、加密、日誌和最小權限。即使問題主要測試另一個網域，安全要求仍然相關。
對於多項回答問題，獨立評估每個選項並僅選擇所需的答案數量。
zh.examTip: 首先閱讀最後一句話，確定所要求的決策，並驗證每個選定的答案是否滿足所有明確的限制。

commonMistakes.title: Common mistakes
commonMistakes.summary: Use this checklist before submitting a AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional practice exam. These mistakes commonly turn a technically possible choice into the wrong exam answer.
points: Do not treat AWS Organizations with delegated administration and SCP guardrails and AWS Transit Gateway as interchangeable. Match the exact capability, scope, and operational model requested by the scenario.
Do not stop at a solution that works. Words such as most secure, least operational effort, lowest cost, and highly available determine which valid design is best.
Do not ignore scope. Confirm whether the requirement applies to one resource, one Availability Zone, one Region, multiple accounts, or a global workload.
Do not confuse high availability, fault tolerance, backup, and disaster recovery. Each addresses a different failure or recovery requirement.
Do not overlook identity, encryption, logging, and least privilege. Security requirements remain relevant even when the question mainly tests another domain.
For multiple-response questions, evaluate every option independently and select only the number of answers requested.
commonMistakes.examTip: Read the final sentence first, identify the decision being requested, and verify that every selected answer satisfies all explicit constraints.

zh.title: 常見錯誤
zh.summary: 在提交 AWS 認證解決方案架構師 - 專業練習考試之前，請使用此清單。這些錯誤通常會將技術上可行的選擇變成錯誤的考試答案。
points: 請勿將具有委派管理和 SCP 護欄的 AWS Organizations 與 AWS Transit Gateway 視為可互換的。匹配場景所要求的確切功能、範圍和操作模型。
不要停留在有效的解決方案上。最安全、最少的營運工作、最低的成本和高度可用性等字詞決定了哪種有效設計是最好的。
不要忽視範圍。確認該要求是否適用於一項資源、一個可用區、一個區域、多個帳戶或全域工作負載。
不要混淆高可用性、容錯、備份和災難復原。每個解決不同的故障或恢復要求。
不要忽視身分、加密、日誌和最小權限。即使問題主要測試另一個網域，安全要求仍然相關。
對於多項回答問題，獨立評估每個選項並僅選擇所需的答案數量。
zh.examTip: 首先閱讀最後一句話，確定所要求的決策，並驗證每個選定的答案是否滿足所有明確的限制。

commonMistakes.title: Common mistakes
commonMistakes.summary: Use this checklist before submitting a AWS Certified Advanced Networking - Specialty practice exam. These mistakes commonly turn a technically possible choice into the wrong exam answer.
points: Do not treat AWS Transit Gateway with route domains and AWS Direct Connect as interchangeable. Match the exact capability, scope, and operational model requested by the scenario.
Do not stop at a solution that works. Words such as most secure, least operational effort, lowest cost, and highly available determine which valid design is best.
Do not ignore scope. Confirm whether the requirement applies to one resource, one Availability Zone, one Region, multiple accounts, or a global workload.
Do not confuse high availability, fault tolerance, backup, and disaster recovery. Each addresses a different failure or recovery requirement.
Do not overlook identity, encryption, logging, and least privilege. Security requirements remain relevant even when the question mainly tests another domain.
For multiple-response questions, evaluate every option independently and select only the number of answers requested.
commonMistakes.examTip: Read the final sentence first, identify the decision being requested, and verify that every selected answer satisfies all explicit constraints.

zh.title: 常見錯誤
zh.summary: 在提交 AWS 認證進階網路 - 專業練習考試之前，請使用此清單。這些錯誤通常會將技術上可行的選擇變成錯誤的考試答案。
points: 請勿將帶有路由域的 AWS Transit Gateway 和 AWS Direct Connect 視為可互換的。匹配場景所要求的確切功能、範圍和操作模型。
不要停留在有效的解決方案上。最安全、最少的營運工作、最低的成本和高度可用性等字詞決定了哪種有效設計是最好的。
不要忽視範圍。確認該要求是否適用於一項資源、一個可用區、一個區域、多個帳戶或全域工作負載。
不要混淆高可用性、容錯、備份和災難復原。每個解決不同的故障或恢復要求。
不要忽視身分、加密、日誌和最小權限。即使問題主要測試另一個網域，安全要求仍然相關。
對於多項回答問題，獨立評估每個選項並僅選擇所需的答案數量。
zh.examTip: 首先閱讀最後一句話，確定所要求的決策，並驗證每個選定的答案是否滿足所有明確的限制。

commonMistakes.title: Common mistakes
commonMistakes.summary: Use this checklist before submitting a AWS Certified Security - Specialty practice exam. These mistakes commonly turn a technically possible choice into the wrong exam answer.
points: Do not treat Amazon GuardDuty and AWS Security Hub as interchangeable. Match the exact capability, scope, and operational model requested by the scenario.
Do not stop at a solution that works. Words such as most secure, least operational effort, lowest cost, and highly available determine which valid design is best.
Do not ignore scope. Confirm whether the requirement applies to one resource, one Availability Zone, one Region, multiple accounts, or a global workload.
Do not confuse high availability, fault tolerance, backup, and disaster recovery. Each addresses a different failure or recovery requirement.
Do not overlook identity, encryption, logging, and least privilege. Security requirements remain relevant even when the question mainly tests another domain.
For multiple-response questions, evaluate every option independently and select only the number of answers requested.
commonMistakes.examTip: Read the final sentence first, identify the decision being requested, and verify that every selected answer satisfies all explicit constraints.

zh.title: 常見錯誤
zh.summary: 在提交 AWS 認證安全性 - 專業練習考試之前，請使用此清單。這些錯誤通常會將技術上可行的選擇變成錯誤的考試答案。
points: 請勿將 Amazon GuardDuty 和 AWS Security Hub 視為可互換。匹配場景所要求的確切功能、範圍和操作模型。
不要停留在有效的解決方案上。最安全、最少的營運工作、最低的成本和高度可用性等字詞決定了哪種有效設計是最好的。
不要忽視範圍。確認該要求是否適用於一項資源、一個可用區、一個區域、多個帳戶或全域工作負載。
不要混淆高可用性、容錯、備份和災難復原。每個解決不同的故障或恢復要求。
不要忽視身分、加密、日誌和最小權限。即使問題主要測試另一個網域，安全要求仍然相關。
對於多項回答問題，獨立評估每個選項並僅選擇所需的答案數量。
zh.examTip: 首先閱讀最後一句話，確定所要求的決策，並驗證每個選定的答案是否滿足所有明確的限制。
